name: Ryujin
subtitle: Sea Serpent
description: Bring the ocean’s protection to your team whilst freezing your foes on the battlefield.
lore: Dragon-god of the seas, Ryujin has always been capricious, and has grown even more so since the Shattering. Although he directs his efforts toward defending Izumo, he often lashes out without forethought, his tempests and tides often causing devastation to his own people nearly as much as they do the realm’s enemies. But Ryujin struggles against his temper, eager to find a purpose.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when hit by an enemy.
